benefits.name: Anniversary free night
benefits.notes: Anniversary Free Night at IHG hotels up to 60,000 points per night (top-up with points allowed).

benefits.name: Spend free night
benefits.notes: Additional Free Night (up to 60,000 points) after $40,000 in purchases each calendar year.

benefits.name: IHG food & beverage reward
benefits.notes: $75 Food & Beverage Reward voucher each quarter for use at IHG hotels.

benefits.name: Airline credit
benefits.notes: $200 statement credit once per calendar year after spending $250+ on flights purchased directly with an airline, through 12/31/2027.

benefits.name: United TravelBank cash
benefits.notes: $25 United TravelBank cash around Jan 5 and Jul 5 each year after a one-time registration at ihg.com/united; Jan-Jun deposits expire Jul 15, Jul-Dec deposits expire Jan 15.

benefits.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck
benefits.notes: Up to $120 statement credit for the Global Entry, TSA PreCheck or NEXUS application fee, once every 4 years.

benefits.name: Instacart credit
benefits.notes: $10 credit in your Instacart+ account each month on one $10+ order paid with the card (3 months of Instacart+ complimentary). Unused credit expires at month end.

benefits.name: DoorDash promo
benefits.notes: $10 off one non-restaurant DoorDash order each calendar month while enrolled in DashPass via the card (12 months complimentary, then paid); applies to DashPass activations from 9/1/2026 (activations 2/1/2025-8/31/2026 get $10 per calendar quarter instead). Offer runs through 12/31/2027.
